nus v0.0.1-preview.8

A terminal, browser and workspace in one application.

Channel: **preview** · Source: `4f351127083717b40370231027058aab540f70b3`

## Changes

- Plot replaces local-site warning tape with four corner markers and quiet survey lines, including matching address and status marks.
- Radiance adds a continuous loading bar with a real HDR highlight on supported native surfaces; stalled loads hold their position and completed loads settle without idle redraws.
- First-window profile onboarding opens automatically again, without repeating in secondary or completed-profile windows.
- Unified reading lists, saved commands, Markdown/JSON/CSV/text viewers, import flow, and Station Port Control improvements.
- Video PiP follows the stream aspect ratio and offers configurable leave/return behavior.
- GitHub update discovery, explicit installation, retained-package recovery, versioned profiles and component compatibility checks.
- Local Mercury claims, encrypted nus-owned sensitive state, local secret redaction, and cross-platform process/file handling fixes.

[Candidate review notes, compatibility and known limitations](https://github.com/cbassuarez/nus/blob/4f351127083717b40370231027058aab540f70b3/docs/releases/v0.0.1-preview.8.md)

## Downloads

| linux-x86_64 | checksum |
| macos-arm64 | ad-hoc |
| windows-x86_64 | unsigned |

Extract the complete package before launching. macOS: move nus.app to Applications. Windows: launch nus.exe. Linux: run ./nus; see README.txt for desktop integration and runtime dependencies.

Preview builds are for early testing. Unsigned Windows previews can show a SmartScreen warning; ad-hoc Mac previews are not notarized. Use the signing column above for this release’s exact status.

nus v0.0.1-preview.7

A terminal, browser and workspace in one application.

Channel: **preview** · Source: `ec36cbeb10a891752af29f833fb797e484d3b446`

## Changes

- A first-open Atlas arrival with perspective star acceleration and clearer Welcome for new and returning installs.
- Themed pin tiles and a palette-only Start/New Tab option.
- Saved reading copies, resume positions and configured encrypted library sync.
- Procedural sky and stars with approximate Sun and Moon motion.
- Stricter release metadata checks and packaging validation.
